reason: NONE. First thing I saw was $29.99 for 30 sachets, which is a dollar a day, and my Nature Made is about 39 cents. I don't pay 2.5 times more for foil packets and a QR code, and two capsules a day sounds like big ones to swallow.
objection: A dollar a serving when I can get magnesium for under 40 cents. A new brand with zero reviews doesn't earn that premium from me.
would_change_my_mind: Price down to around 50 cents a day (about $15 for the box), plus a pile of real reviews saying the capsules are small and easy to swallow.
